newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 8.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Tuesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Japan and the United States plan to release by May joint interim report on possible revision of guidelines on defence cooperation.
-- The U.S. Secretary of Defence William Cohen says United States will keep current armed forces level in Japan.
-- More Japanese capital outflow is seen due to widening interest rate differentials with the United States.
-- A Nihon Keizai Shimbun survey of 661 companies on wage increases shows that negotiations for this spring will be unchanged from a year earlier at 2.75 percent.
